The Category-9 gate stands between project evidence and the categories that consume it, and enforces structurally: a qualified signal's band and value are unreadable when the verdict refuses, and the converter into the combination refuses a raw bypass with an exception. NO BOUNDARY, BAND OR MODULE ARITHMETIC MOVED.
